kind: PG-G current-policy baseline, independent parent/symmetry sibling
selectionMethod: All root data/families/family-{P|R}nnnnn-symmetry-manifest.json blobs in pinned tree. Exclude exactly the six historic causal-development cohort parents. Sort 32-bit FNV1a of salt + ':' + parentId unsigned ascending, tie parentId lexicographic. Freeze first 12 without inspecting historic or current solver outcomes.
sourceInventoryCaveat: Current pinned direct root inventory yields 50 manifests and 44 non-development parents; an older research report asserted 54/48. This plan uses verified tree facts, not an unsupported prior count.
stageA: Baseline-only current policy: for each of 12 parents and seven symmetry siblings, run each of three methods at identical 10M isolated work. No parent-frame ordering treatment, no seed normalization. Freeze any orientation-discordant solve-state cases before Stage B.
stageB: If discordance exposure exists and Stage A is source-valid, intervene on discordant siblings only with parent-frame order using current puzzle plus historical transform for research causality, never cold runtime. Promotion requires separately successful current-input consumer.
canary: Execute one parent/variant technique at lower dose to validate API, instrumentation, source mapping and work accounting; its outcomes must not alter parent selection.
scope: 12 independent historical non-development parent families, 7 sibling transformations per parent; within-family siblings are not independent.
